scopes.product: Application UI: foundations, controls, navigation, data, overlays, feedback, app patterns (always on)
scopes.marketing: Website / landing UI: hero, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, footers, marketing pages (add when the product has a public site)
scopes.ai: AI & chat UI: conversation, streaming, tools, approvals, citations, AI labelling, assistant layouts (add when the product ships an assistant or agent)
scopes.commerce: Commerce UI: product cards, variant pickers, cart, checkout, orders, reviews, PLP/PDP/cart/checkout pages (add for stores and marketplaces)
scopes.email: HTML email: table layouts, bulletproof buttons, dark-mode-safe templates for transactional and marketing email (add when the product sends email)
